# Ice-shake references (research only)

This directory contains ten CC0 Freesound preview files from the `creeeeak`
`ice cubes` pack. The source descriptions mention rolling or shaking ice in a
glass/jar, so these clips are useful for transient/onset and hard-negative
inspection. They do **not** report a measured cube count, use a ColdKeep bottle,
or use the phone capture protocol.

The files must therefore remain outside `dataset/manifest.csv` and must never
be mapped to `none`, `few`, or `many`. The machine-readable source pages,
preview URLs, descriptions, and SHA256 hashes are in `manifest.csv`. Every row
has `production_label_eligible=false`; the external probe enforces that guard.

The checked-in bytes are Freesound HQ MP3 previews rather than the original
uploads. They are kept only to make feature-probe results reproducible. The
source pages displayed Creative Commons 0 at retrieval time; re-check the
source terms before any redistribution or augmentation.
